transport: existing private SSM tunnel, TLS verify-full, local port 15432
observed_baseline: 23 migration versions ending 20261027112205; matches candidate prefix by version. The database ledger does not prove historical file checksums.
effects: Apply nine hash-checked SQL migrations, in order, and record their versions. They change shared Listings and Search catalogue labels, index and price constraints, listing trigger; add Identity handle projection and encrypted notification addresses; add Conversations retry fields/index and Identity email preference.
Grant the existing Identity application role SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE only on identity.notification_destinations; no new role, secret, PUBLIC grant, or broader Conversations privilege.
execution: Verify existing non-root AWS identity, target and source hashes; reread existing database master credential only into process memory. Run guarded helper once. A single transaction contains all migrations, ledger inserts and the Identity grant; it refuses an unexpected baseline and rolls back known failures. A lost connection or ambiguous commit requires inspection before any retry.
validation: Locally passed PostgreSQL rehearsal on the reviewed 23-file baseline, including retained synthetic data, hash rejection, repeat refusal, and rollback when a later constraint fails. Live checks compare final ledger and effective privileges without exposing user data.
risks: The migrations include shared-domain data/schema changes and may reject incompatible existing rows. Applied migration changes are persistent; do not automatically roll back, reset or delete data. Shared owner review remains relevant. One transaction can hold locks; the API is stopped and lock/statement timeouts are enforced.
cleanup: Keep existing protected host and RDS running for subsequent approved build and testing; do not stop, scale in, terminate or destroy resources until separately approved by Aditya. Deadline and spend threshold of the baseline window remain.
approval: Explicit approval of this exact plan SHA-256 is required before SQL mutation.
